## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] `./gradlew check` passes, or the omitted gate is explained.
- [ ] Public API, persistence, parser, security, and performance effects were considered where relevant.
- [ ] User-facing documentation and release notes were updated where relevant.

## Licensing

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), accepting the [CLA](../CLA.md) via the DCO trailer.
